scripts.dev:app: concurrently -k -n client,server "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install && npx prisma db push && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.build:render: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install && npx prisma db push && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
